title: lecanopteris linguiformis
intro: Lecanopteris linguiformis, commonly known as the Tongue Fern or Lecanopteris, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. The Tongue Fern is a medicinal plant traditionally used in Southeast Asian cultures for its various health benefits. It is valued for its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Lecanopteris linguiformis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and potential health benefits.
